Session date: 8:57 pm on 6 October, 2023
[D11:1] Sam: Hey Evan, long time no see! I've started eating healthier - what's new with you? Picked up any new hobbies?
[...]
[D11:3] Sam: Hey Evan, sorry to hear about your knee. It must be tough. Are there any ways to stay active while you heal up?
[D11:4] Evan: Thanks, Sam. PT has helped some. I can't do intense workouts, but I'm doing easy exercises to keep it strong. Not as good as being active outdoors, but still something.
[D11:5] Sam: Glad PT is helping, Evan! Taking care of yourself is key – have you explored any fun indoor activities or hobbies?
[D11:6] Evan: I do my favorite watercolor painting to keep me busy. It's a chill way to relax and get into the colors. By the way, something happened two weeks ago! You're not gonna believe this, I had a bit of an adventure recently. Helped a lost tourist find their way, and we ended up taking an unexpected tour around the city. It was a blast!
[D11:7] Sam: Hey Evan, that sounds like a fun and unexpected event! It's always interesting how helping someone can turn into a little adventure of its own. And how's your watercolor painting going?
[D11:8] Evan: It's been great! I find painting to be a great stress reliever. Here's what I did last week.
[D11:9] Sam: Wow, those are awesome! So cool. Where did you get the inspiration for them?
